dct_creator_sm: Skinner, Ernest Meeson (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Gitanmaax Band reserves Gitanmaax 1 and Anlaw 4 along the Skeena River near Hazelton. Land cover and features described on the map include the town of Hazelton, graves, village, cemetery, Hagwilget River [Bulkley River], gardens, trails, a canon, and types of soil, land, and timber. Based upon the district name in the plan title, this land was originally part of Cassiar Land District. Surveyed by E.M. Skinner, 1898. [Signed by A.W. Vowell, Indian Reserve Commissioner, no date.] [Approved by F. Carter-Cotton, Chief Commissioner of Lands and Works, 24 April 1899.]
